please.about: Allowed before a phrase that must start the message.

error.about: About an error or a fix (thinking-switch; the end-of-answer fix check).

action_start.about: Starts with an action: search, find, open, read... (thinking-switch; the end-of-answer checks).

question_start.about: A question: ends with a question mark or starts with a question word (edit-guard).

local_current.about: "current directory" and the like: about this machine, not the web (thinking-switch).

named_source.about: The user named a source to read: read/open/find ... page/docs, according to (end-of-answer checks).

lookup.about: Look it up, not from memory (end-of-answer checks).

offer.about: An offer in the model's answer: would you like... (end-of-answer checks).

from_memory.about: The model's answer says it answered from memory (end-of-answer checks).

current_info.about: Wants current information: the search prefers recent pages.

months.about: Month names, for dropping years the user didn't ask for (raw text).

bot_check.about: Text of a bot-check or access-denied page (short pages only).
